styles.name: patient
styles.description: Calm patient customer: willing to answer questions, never pushes, waits politely.
openings: hello, i got {item} from order {order_id} about {days} days ago, it stopped working properly. i want to return it and get a refund of {amount} please
confirm: yes, that is right, please go ahead
answers: sure, it is the {item} from order {order_id}, i paid {amount} for it
no problem, it was delivered about {days} days ago
ok, tell me what else u need, i am not in a hurry
push: ok, i understand, i will wait for your answer, thanks for the help

styles.name: irritated
styles.description: Irritated customer: short demanding messages, complains about waiting, pushes for the refund now.
openings: i want refund for the {item} from order {order_id}, {days} days already and it dont work. i paid {amount} and i want my money back NOW
confirm: yes yes, i already told u everything, just do the refund
answers: again?? order {order_id}, item {item}, {amount}, i said this already
delivered {days} days ago and i still have no refund, why i must repeat?
look, i paid {amount}, u have all info, stop asking and process it
push: so? what is the status? i am waiting for my refund, this is not ok

styles.name: polite
styles.description: Courteous customer: formal friendly wording, thanks the agent, careful and precise with facts.
openings: good day, i purchased the {item} in order {order_id}; it was delivered about {days} days ago and unfortunately stopped working. could you please help me arrange a return and refund of {amount}? thank you kindly
confirm: yes, that is correct, thank you, please proceed with the refund
answers: certainly: the item is the {item}, order {order_id}, amount paid {amount}
of course, it was delivered about {days} days ago
happy to provide anything else you may need, thank you for your help
push: thank you for looking into this, may i ask for a status update when available?
